name: FrontierMath
intro: FrontierMath 是由 60+ 位数学家创作并盲审的数百道原创、未发表高级数学题。命题必须满足原创、可自动核验、不可猜中和计算可处理四项要求；模型可在交互式 Python 环境中实验，最终答案由精确匹配、SymPy 等价或自定义脚本自动评分。
build_method: 专家原创命题, 领域专家盲审, 原创性与污染检查, 自动验证
task_type: 高级数学推理, 实验式代码求解
eval_feature: 未发表题目, 自动验证, 低污染风险, 三维专家难度
scale: 数百道原创题；覆盖约 70% 的 MSC2020 顶级学科
intro_en: FrontierMath contains hundreds of original, unpublished advanced-mathematics problems authored and blind-reviewed by 60+ mathematicians. Problems must be original, automatically verifiable, guessproof, and computationally tractable; models may experiment in Python before exact, SymPy, or custom-script verification of the final answer.
build_method_en: Expert original problem writing, blind domain review, originality and contamination checks, automatic verification
task_type_en: Advanced Mathematical Reasoning, Experiment-enabled Code Solving
eval_feature_en: Unpublished Problems, Automated Verification, Low Contamination Risk, Three-dimensional Expert Difficulty
scale_en: Hundreds of original problems; about 70% of top-level MSC2020 subjects
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2411.04872 Sections 2 and 4. More than 60 mathematicians write new unpublished problems under four requirements: originality, automated verifiability, guessproofness, and computational tractability. Each package includes a statement, detailed solution, verification script, subject and technique tags, and difficulty metadata. At least one blind domain expert checks correctness, ambiguity, guessability, code, classifications, and difficulty. Secure handling, expert source checks, Quetext, and Copyscape reduce contamination. Difficulty is background 1–5 plus creativity and execution hours—not Tier 1–4. Models experiment in Python, submit a self-contained pickled object, and are graded by exact, SymPy, or custom verification.
